steps: Inspect visually: confirm RJ45 cables are connected in the correct positions; confirm all cables are seated and link LEDs are green.
If LED indicates the failure side: reseat the BMC interposer cable and the sideband cable (check both ends).
If still failing for the same reason: reseat the BMC module.
Replace the BMC module. Escalate to TE/EE/QCI if repeated pattern or suspect batch issue.
items.notes: DMR: record side, cable positions verified, LED state, and what was reseated/replaced.
